label: NUP98::NSD1

sections.text: NUP98 encodes a nuclear pore protein with an amino-terminal region involved in transport and transcriptional regulation.
NSD1 encodes a histone H3 lysine-36 methyltransferase.

The fusion retains the amino-terminal FG-repeat region of NUP98 and creates an abnormal transcriptional regulator associated with sustained HOX-gene expression. The NSD1 partner contributes chromatin-regulatory activity, and FLT3-ITD is a frequent cooperating alteration.
NUP98-rearranged pediatric AML has been associated with poor treatment outcomes in large cohorts; the strongest partner-specific evidence is for NSD1 and KDM5A.
